comment: There is one output jack, not the stereo pair sickoPlayer has, and no cue or loop cursors: the whole file is the cycle. The waveform display is a custom widget with no ParamWidget, so its right-click menu — which carries the same Load Sample and Samples Browser items — cannot be reached by clicking it for help; the module's own menu carries them too. The output range is ±5V only with the LIM switch on; with it off the level depends on the file and the master knob.
